items.title: Henry "Booker T." Glass Interview, 1962-03-22
items.q: Did you ever know that guy called Doug used to play around the district and went up north?

ctx.x: Yeah, they had a lot of them used to come around and just sit down and play for nothing. Just go around the place and play for nothing. Come in the ballrooms and play and they'd play. Like around in the district, they'd just come sit in there and play.
Did you ever know that guy called Doug used to play around the district and went up north?
